info.name: Validate and verify a phone number

params.name: api_key
params.description: Your Abstract API Phone Validation API key.

params.name: phone
params.description: The phone number to validate and verify, ideally in E.164 format (e.g. +14152007986).

params.name: country
params.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used to interpret a phone number submitted without an international dialing code.

items.docs: Validates a single phone number and returns validity, local and international formats, country, registered location, line type, and carrier. The number should be supplied in E.164 format (for example +14152007986); an optional country hint can help interpret numbers supplied without a country code.
